evidence: Has the Mining label and modifies src/interfaces/mining.h, src/node/block_template_manager.*, and mining IPC Cap'n Proto definitions.
rationale: Fixes a ThreadSanitizer-confirmed data race on m_block_template members when concurrent IPC worker threads call submitSolution() while others read via getBlockHeader() or getBlock() (#36515). It also stabilizes external miner interface operations by exposing cached total fees to avoid cross-process fee summation roundtrips.
